title: Implement Modal ephemeral provider wrapper
description:
Create chatbot/providers/modal_ephemeral.py implementing the Provider interface for ephemeral Modal container compute.

This wrapper handles cold-start, calls an ephemeral Modal-deployed endpoint that serves a model, and performs teardown. It implements the same Provider complete() contract as openai_compat.py so the router can swap without changing calling code.

The wrapper must:
- Accept Modal app name/function reference, optional volume mount config, and cold-start timeout configuration.
- On first complete() call, trigger a Modal Function.spawn or lookup, wait for readiness, and cache the handle.
- Translate ProviderConfig into the payload for the Modal endpoint.
- Map Modal response into ProviderResponse.
- Handle cold-start timeouts by raising ProviderTimeoutError.
- Handle auth/connection errors by raising ProviderAuthError.
- Support a teardown/close method that stops the ephemeral container.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/operations.md
- chatbot/providers/base.py (the Provider interface and error hierarchy)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY chatbot/providers/modal_ephemeral.py. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, or any code outside the listed path. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: implement async complete() per Provider ABC
forbidden: add routing or fallback logic (that belongs in router.py)
